jobs.name: Maintenance Worker
jobs.description: Take maintenance trains out to faulty signals, track and platforms, protect the work area and make repairs.

jobs.name: Train Operator
jobs.description: Drive passenger trains: take a service, prepare the train, stop at every station and keep to time.

jobs.name: Signaler
jobs.description: Run a signal box: set routes, move points and keep trains safely apart on the live track diagram.

jobs.name: Guard
jobs.description: Ride a passenger train: open the doors on the platform side, manage boarding and tell the operator when it is ready to depart.

jobs.name: Dispatcher
jobs.description: Work one station's platforms: send Train Ready To Start, close the doors and give each train the Right Away when its signal is clear.

jobs.name: Station Staff
jobs.description: Keep the stations clean: pick up litter, mop spills, empty the bins and take the trash out, then ride a train to the next station that needs you.
